description_for_human: Search, read, and cite Alabama civic and legislative meetings indexed by cicada.guide.
description_for_model: Plugin for searching, reading, and citing civic and legislative meetings indexed by cicada.guide. Use searchMeetings to find relevant meeting excerpts for a plain-English question, getMeeting to read a full transcript, getMember for an elected official's profile, getBill for bill details, and listBodies to see available governing bodies. Always cite the meetingId, speaker, and timestamp for any claim drawn from search or meeting results.
